repairs.quote: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing (60/85/110/135/160 + (70% bonus Attack Damage) + (60% Ability Power)) to all enemies it cuts through. Hitting non-champions reduces the damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of 40%. The damage falloff resets upon beginning its return. Damage scales with Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 40% effectiveness. Cast time scales down with Attack Speed
